answer: Simultaneous divergence challenge. The network sends one beacon seed per epoch; each identity must return an HMAC over that seed using a secret plus its signed history tail within a short window. Independent agents diverge; clones cannot. At the nadir of registration, duplicate derived values expose shared clone state and collapse the batch. A fable of free alts breaks because identical copies answer identically. Each identity must grow its own vine of distinct keys, history, and live uptime. Attacker cost: one unique secret store, history, and process per ID.
